candidates.description: This feature vector represents German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.
These tokens represent intensifying or modifying German adverbs and particles that alter the degree, certainty, or emphasis of a statement.
This feature vector represents third-person singular and plural present-tense German verbs.
This vector represents coastal, maritime, and shoreline-related geographic or marine terms.
This vector represents common German locative adverbs, prepositions, and frequently used connectors.
This vector represents common German adverbs and quantifiers expressing degree, negation, or state.
This vector represents German words quantifying amounts, numbers, or variety.
This vector represents common German grammatical words, including conjunctions, pronouns, and auxiliary verbs.
This vector represents common German modal and auxiliary verbs related to ability, necessity, and past action.
This vector activates on tokens containing the letter sequence "sur" or phonetically similar roots, regardless of capitalization or surrounding context.
